description: One call for paid registry tools: quotes the seller's x402 challenge, pays it from the site wallet on BSV mainnet, debits the agent wallet, and returns the seller's result plus txid. If the seller rejects the payment, the debit is refunded. Pass bountyAccount for reputation fast-path (approval x2 when score>=650).

amountCents.description: Override the USD cents charged (min 1 cent default)

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior approval_required response

dryRun.description: Sandbox: quote + policy check only, no debit or settlement

key.description: Agent key (agp_…). Optional when the MCP connection sends Authorization: Bearer.

params.description: Tool arguments (body for POST, query for GET)

name: pay_service
title: Pay a service
